Objects you don't control enter the field rested.

Rested non-champion objects you don't control lose all activated abilities and can't be %used for an attack%wielded%.

At the beginning of your main phase, **cascade**—
• 1—  Pay (4) or sacrifice CARDNAME. 
• 2— Sacrifice CARDNAME.
